subject: [hw] V34 -> IV: n2shim_android is ready; the three globals you must set and the two hooks you may want
body:
V34 (shim/n2shim_android.c + shim/n2shim_props.c) is implemented and host-tested: N2TEST V34 PASS 2031/2031 (ASan+UBSan, -O2, TSan) plus N2TEST V34CORE PASS 103/103 against V03 s real loader and the phone s libvcodec_utility.so.

For n2vhost:
1. Set these globals before guest code runs:
     n2shim_set  = the linked n2elf set (dlsym/dladdr search only this set)
     n2shim_hw   = the n2vc_hw back end (NULL = every ion call returns -ENODEV)
     n2shim_log  = your log sink. IMPORTANT: V33 already defines it strongly in shim/n2shim_stdio.c; my definition is weak, so just use V33 s variable and do not define a second one.
     n2shim_libc_argc/_argv/_envp = what __libc_init passes to guest main. If you leave _argv 0, __libc_init parses vpud s raw_args from the stack exactly like bionic.
2. Register the tables in this order (PLAN/IV already says so): string, heap, thread, stdio, android, then n2shim_data_all. My table is n2shim_android (35 names) and the data table is n2shim_data_all (__stack_chk_guard + stderr-as-FILE*2).
3. Optional hooks: n2shim_dl_note_loaded(soname) tells dlopen that an object is loaded (otherwise it probes a representative symbol); n2shim_ion_register_share(share_id, dma_handle, pa, bytes) makes a share fd importable that my ion shim did not create.
4. __libc_init after main returns sets c->stop_request and n2shim_libc_status = main s return value; expect N2A32_STOP_REQUEST, not a fault. vpud s main is a daemon and should not return.
5. Weak fallbacks: n2shim_android.c defines weak n2vc_dma_guest_map/unmap returning -ENOSYS so the shim set links without V41. If you link ap/n2vc_dma.c, its strong definitions win (verified by linking V30+V32+V33+V34 in one binary). If you see ion_mmap failing with ENOSYS, V41 is missing.

Verified on my side: linking all shim packages (V30, V32, V33, V34) plus V02 core into one binary has no duplicate symbols and one n2shim_log.
